craft_notes: Sthāyin: hailing power. Device: end-dash→comma (hailed softly, might released). Rejected: 'thrice' adverb — kept triples (verb). Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Hail triple-earth's king, hail thee, Becoming, hailed of thy haunters,
hail the unlet might that triples kingship.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namas trailokyanāthāya tubhyaṃ bhava bhavajjuṣām trilokīnāthatādānanirvināyakaśaktaye
